proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11392.2 varṣa gives Prakrit varisa, Hindi baras, Old Marwari barasa, Gujarati varas, Bihari baris and northwestern varh-/varih- forms for “year”. Punjabi varas/baras is explicitly a Central loan; conservative ś/ṣ forms and local retroflex innovations are held rather than inferred automatically. Comparative check: had varas “year” (f_lvi57orxrbgby). The exact survey spelling and phonetic marks remain untouched. Stress, vowel articulation, release marks and source palatal/sibilant notation were reviewed as local details; the full form and sense support the same family. The link does not settle uncertain transfer within Indo-Aryan.
